cohort: The study included 156 ASA II patients undergoing lower segment caesarean sections (LSCS).
finding: Hyperbaric bupivacaine provided the longest sensory and motor block duration and quickest onset of anesthesia, while hyperbaric ropivacaine facilitated the fastest postoperative recovery.
mod_finding: This study found that different hyperbaric local anesthetics used for spinal anesthesia during LSCS (caesarean delivery) impact block characteristics and recovery times, with bupivacaine offering the longest block and ropivacaine the fastest recovery.
